snippet.title: CRABRUN | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4633560/CRABRUN

Face an unforgiving arcade ecosystem made up of simple rules and filled with subtle interactions. Learn to walk sideways, dash through danger, and combo your way to an absurdly high score. The gods of the sea reward persistence and style in CRABRUN.
